name: x402-exact
description: HTTP 402 pay-per-request starter using native Xian token settlement.
use_case: Expose paid APIs or agent tools that charge a fixed Xian token amount per request while keeping payment verification and settlement in a reusable facilitator path.

starter_flows.name: local
starter_flows.summary: Run a local indexed node, deploy the x402 settlement contract, start the paid API, and buy one protected resource.

steps.title: Create and start the local indexed node
commands: uv run xian network create x402-exact-local --template single-node-indexed --chain-id x402-exact-local-1 --generate-validator-key --init-node
uv run xian node start validator-1
uv run xian node endpoints validator-1
notes: Run these commands from the xian-cli checkout.
Use the reported RPC URL as XIAN_NODE_URL.

steps.title: Deploy the settlement contract
notes: Run these commands from the xian-py checkout.
Set XIAN_NODE_URL, XIAN_CHAIN_ID, and XIAN_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY for the deployer/facilitator wallet.

steps.title: Run the paid API
notes: Set XIAN_X402_PAY_TO to the seller account. If omitted, the example uses the service wallet.

steps.title: Buy the protected resource
notes: Use a buyer wallet funded with the configured token. The buyer signs the x402 payment and permit payloads locally.
